targetText: As soon as the rising generation of the new society attains its majority all further development is left to the individual.
summary: Freed from commercial patronage and the capitalist division of labor, art, literature, theater, and scientific research in socialist society will flourish on an unprecedented scale as every individual enjoys abundant leisure to cultivate their creative and intellectual talents.
